selected_benchmarks.description: Paper-level CPU comparison target from Table 1, evaluated in this reproduction on a small subset extracted from the paper's released benchmark archive with raw VFB as the local ablation baseline. Size ratio is the paper's average size ratio target; reproduced scores use the median common-task size ratio against the local ablation baseline.

solve_rate.description: Fraction of slice instances for which the returned formula independently separates positive from negative traces.

evaluation_coverage.description: Fraction of slice instances for which the method emitted an output row, preventing omission of hard cases from improving rates.

formula_size_ratio.description: Median returned-formula size ratio against the raw VFB ablation on instances both methods solve.

all_returned_formulas_valid.description: Whether every non-empty returned formula is syntactically parseable and semantically valid on its traces.

mean_collapse_ratio.description: Average reduction from generated LTLf characteristic tables to distinct first-position Boolean atoms.

solve_rate_delta_vs_baseline.description: Solve-rate improvement over the raw bounded VFB ablation on the same slice.

baseline_miss_solve_rate.description: Fraction of raw-VFB-unsolved slice instances that the method solves, targeting the Boolean-set-cover benefit.
